title: Quantifying Label-Induced Bias in Large Language Model Self- and Cross-Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM evaluations of blog posts under four controlled authorship attribution conditions (no labels, true labels, and two false-attribution scenarios) using holistic preference voting and granular point-based quality ratings.

Measuring how frequently language models select their own generated outputs as the 'best' and how their point-based quality ratings shift when evaluating their own content versus content generated by other models.
